Stop letting Claude Code burn through your tokens — these 4 plugins can seriously upgrade your workflow.

First, Ponytail — optimizes Claude Code’s output and can reduce unnecessary token usage while keeping the results accurate.
Second, OmniRoute — automatically switches between AI providers when you hit a usage limit, giving you access to a much larger pool of available tokens.
Third, Graphify — turns your codebase into a knowledge graph, helping your agent understand your project without repeatedly re-reading the same files.
And finally, AgentSkills — a collection of skills designed to help Claude handle different stages of development, from planning and coding to testing and publishing.
Four plugins. One Claude Code workflow. A lot less friction.
